Where we started


### Matillion ETL

We went to market with Matillion ETL — an on-premise solution trusted by thousands of companies. Many of our customers still rely on it today.


![Group 6411](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Group-6411.png)![Matillion Horizontal 2 Colour Dark 1](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Matillion-Horizontal-2-Colour-Dark-1.png)

The productivity leap


### Data Productivity Cloud

Next we brought the Data Productivity Cloud to market: drag-and-drop pipeline creation delivering 3x the productivity of writing SQL by hand.


![Group 6410](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Group-6410.png)![Maia By Matillion Dark 1](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Maia-By-Matillion-Dark-1.png)

The agentic era


### Maia

With Maia, the Data Productivity Cloud became Maia Foundation — and we added Maia Team on top as the agentic layer that builds and manages pipelines for you.


![Group 6452](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Group-6452.png)

![](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/Wooden-texture-with-shadows-1.png)

#### Why we're built to win with agents

The Data Productivity Cloud was built from reusable, governed components. So instead of writing SQL from a blank page, Maia reaches for a proven component and places it on the canvas. That component-first foundation is what sets us apart from agentic tools starting from scratch — Maia builds on fifteen years of pipeline engineering, not guesswork.
